title: Crab Derby, 2019 · before
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The day before the thirty-fifth: the girl, nine, at the counter with a photo of a real crab propped against the tank, drawing from it, and it's good, and Wood at the end stool watching the cartoon leave the flyer. He doesn't say anything. Gully says it's good. She says she knows.

panels.composition: The shack. The GIRL, nine, drawing from a photo of a real crab propped on the tank. WOOD on the stool. GULLY. The PUP.
